fusions.name: Hobbling Throw
fusions.desc: A lashing throw that deals 5 damage, with a 35% chance of [Slowed] reducing the target's movement for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Corral
fusions.desc: Closes in on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage with a 40% chance of [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Paddock
fusions.desc: Raises a line of force 6.5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything struck moves 16% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightening Mesh
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your damage rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
